rejeitadas.descricao_resumida: Ovative Group - Chicago, Ilinóis, Estados Unidos
rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
About Ovative Group
Ovative Group is an independent, full-funnel media, measurement, and creative firm transforming how brands grow. We partner with leading names like American Eagle, Best Buy, Domino’s, The Home Depot, Polaris, and UnitedHealth Group to build smarter media and measurement programs that drive real, profitable growth.
We don’t just track performance—we redefine it. Powered by our proprietary intelligence platform, EMRge, and our holistic metric Enterprise Marketing Return (EMR), we help brands connect revenue, customer, and brand outcomes into one clear picture of success. Our approach to full-funnel strategy, buying, and measurement delivers results that matter—and it’s getting noticed. Our work has been recognized by Digiday, Google, USA Today, Inc. 5000, and Search Engine Land.
About The Role
We are seeking an Analyst, Data & Software Engineering to join our Client Delivery team within the Enterprise Client organization. This team is the operational front door for the EMRge product suite — we own first-line support, client onboarding execution, ongoing client maintenance, and GA product/feature rollouts, in partnership with our Product and Measurement teams.
In this role, you'll execute assigned data and software engineering work within a clearly scoped project, working under the guidance of senior engineers and your DE Manager. You'll help diagnose and resolve client-impacting issues, support client onboarding using existing implementation patterns, and contribute to the ongoing operational health of client solutions built on EMRge. You'll work directly with more senior engineers and, over time, with Product Managers and business stakeholders, to understand the “why” behind the work and build a foundation for translating business needs into technical execution.
You'll be encouraged to build strong engineering fundamentals — version control, testing, documentation — while also learning to use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your day-to-day workflow. This is a great seat for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to real client systems, production support, and a fast-paced, collaborative engineering team.
Responsibilities
Execute assigned data engineering and software development tasks within a defined project scope and timeline.
Support first-line triage, diagnosis, and resolution of client-impacting technical issues, escalating appropriately when an issue requires deeper product-team investigation.
Assist with client onboarding and offboarding execution using established EMRge patterns and tooling.
Contribute to recurring client maintenance work, including monitoring, break-fix support, and operational upkeep of existing implementations.
Document your work, outputs, and any technical debt created during delivery, so others can pick up where you left off.
Write tests and follow existing documentation and code-quality standards; flag opportunities to improve them.
Communicate blockers, risks, and progress proactively to senior engineers and your manager.
Participate in scoping and requirements discussions as needed to inform feasibility.
Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) to support your workflow, under the guidance of senior teammates on responsible use.
Collaborate with cross-functional partners (Data Science, Measurement, Product) as work requires.
Qualifications
REQUIRED:
0–1 years of experience creating software or working with data pipelines (internships, coursework, or professional experience all count).
Experience with Python and SQL.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
Strong written and oral communication skills.
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable asking questions to clarify ambiguity.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, client-driven environment where priorities can shift.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Preferred
Exposure to cloud platforms (GCP or AWS) or cloud data warehouses.
Coursework or project experience with ETL/data pipeline concepts.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude for coding, or similar).
Interest in or exposure to marketing, media, or advertising — helps in understanding client processes and the data you'll be working with.
Experience working on a team using Agile or iterative development practices.
Pay Transparency
At Ovative, we offer a transparent view into three core components of the total compensation package: Base Salary, Annual Bonus, and Benefits.
For our Analyst positions, including the position of Analyst, Data & Software Engineering our compensation range is $60,000 - 66,000 on an annualized basis, which is inclusive of an annual bonus opportunity of 10% of base salary.
Working At Ovative Group
We provide strong, competitive, holistic benefits that understand the importance of your life inside and out of work.
At Ovative, culture isn’t a buzzword—it’s the reason we’ve been named a Top Workplace for ten years running. We lead with trust, transparency, and a commitment to doing the hard work others avoid.
We offer flexibility. You'll work from our Minneapolis, Chicago, or New York office on set days each week, and an option to work remote on others.
Our open floor plan reflects our open communication and flat structure—where interns collaborate with VPs, analysts partner with senior leaders, and our CEO engages with every team member. Together, we create an environment where smart, driven people can do their best work and support one another in the process.
We’re equally committed to inclusion and belonging. Ovative fosters a workplace where everyone can participate and thrive—regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression or other protected class status. Our benefits and policies reflect that commitment, from inclusive medical leave coverage for same-sex spouses to equitable care and support for all families.
Benefits
We strive to hire and retain the best talent by offering fair, competitive compensation, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent health coverage. When the company performs well, we all benefit.
Some Tangible Benefits And Amenities We Enjoy
Access to all office spaces in MSP, NYC, and CHI  
Frequent, paid travel to our Minneapolis headquarters for company events, team events, and in-person collaboration with teams
Generous paid vacation policy  
401k match program  
Top-notch health insurance options, inclusive of same sex partners 
Family formation benefits including reimbursement options for fertility, pregnancy, and parenting needs 
Monthly stipend for your mobile phone and data plan  
Sabbatical program  
Charitable giving via our time and a financial match program  
Shenanigan’s Day  
Additional information can be found at Ovative's Career Page.
The details of the benefits are covered by applicable plan documents for group benefits and by company policies where a plan document does not apply.
Working at Ovative won’t be easy—but if you like challenging, hard work, driving results, and being surrounded by the best talent, it has the potential to be the most rewarding job you’ll ever have. If you think you can make us better, we want to hear from you!
EEO & Accessibility
Ovative is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a respectful, inclusive workplace for all. Applicants receive consideration without regard to legally protected characteristics (e.g., color, religion, creed, national origin, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity/, gender expression, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, marital/ status, familial status, military or veteran’s status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, and any other status protected under applicable law).
We provide reasonable accommodations consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state law to qualified applicants and employees with disability, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.
If you need assistance or accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process due to a disability, please contact us at application.accomodations@ovative.com.
Application Details And Process
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer on a full-time basis, without current or future need for visa sponsorship. Ovative is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification documentation upon hire.
Open Until Filled Or Otherwise Withdrawn
We encourage interested candidates to apply early. The position will remain open for at least 10 business days from the first day of posting. After this time, if the position has not been filled, the posting will remain open until the position is filled, or until the posting is otherwise closed or withdrawn for business reasons.

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Software Engineering
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Software Engineer — Automation & Reliability
aMTS - Junior
Mexico City
About The Role
Help build the next generation of AI-powered engineering. Join our AI-native Academy as an early-career software engineer to solve real production challenges, build intelligent automation and strengthen system reliability. With hands-on guidance from a senior mentor, you’ll combine software development with production support experience, building the skills to grow into broader product and platform engineering roles.
You’ll investigate support cases, troubleshoot production issues and participate in support rotations—gaining firsthand insight into how complex systems work and where they can improve. Your mandate goes beyond resolving individual issues: you’ll build software, AI agents and tools that eliminate recurring manual work and prevent problems from returning.
Your projects could include agentic Tier 1/2 case automation, automated access workflows, technical knowledge retrieval, log analysis and system hardening. You’ll write, test, review and deploy code, with opportunities to own improvements from identifying the problem to measuring the result.
As you demonstrate strong engineering skills and measurable impact, you’ll have opportunities to graduate into core product engineering teams, based on your readiness and business needs. It’s a chance to learn through practical ownership, deliver meaningful improvements and build a foundation for your software engineering career.
What You’ll Do
Investigate and resolve support cases, production defects, access issues and integration failures.
Build automation for recurring tasks such as access requests, case responses, log analysis, troubleshooting and maintenance.
Develop AI agents and workflows that help classify cases, retrieve relevant knowledge and execute approved actions with appropriate safeguards.
Identify root causes and improve code, monitoring, tests and documentation to prevent recurring incidents.
Write, test, review and deploy maintainable software using established engineering practices.
Participate in incident response and scheduled support or on-call rotations, with training and guidance appropriate to your experience.
Work with senior mentors and product teams to understand systems, prioritize improvements and deliver changes safely.
Measure the impact of your work through reduced manual effort, fewer repeat issues, faster resolution and improved reliability.
What You’ll Bring
Foundational programming skills in at least one language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript or Go.
An understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, APIs, testing, version control and debugging.
An ability to investigate problems using logs, error messages and system behavior.
Curiosity about automation, AI-assisted development and reliable production systems.
Clear communication, a collaborative approach and a willingness to ask questions and learn from feedback.
A degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
We welcome evidence of your skills from internships, coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions or professional experience. The scope and independence expected will reflect the level of the role.
Helpful Experience
Building scripts, internal tools or workflow automation.
Salesforce platform working knowledge preferably with Salesforce admin certification & APEX hands on experience - or desire to obtain certification.
Working with cloud platforms, databases, CI/CD pipelines or monitoring tools.
Developing or integrating AI agents, large language models or knowledge retrieval systems.
Supporting enterprise applications or investigating production incidents.
Applying secure coding practices, access controls and audit logging.
How You’ll Grow
You’ll receive mentoring, code review and practical experience across the software development lifecycle. As you demonstrate engineering capability and measurable impact, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to increasingly complex systems and broader product development, based on your readiness and team needs.
Success means solving today’s problems while building software that reduces tomorrow’s manual work.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and 
be your best
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can 
do your best
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
Accommodations
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
Forward Deployed Engineer
Experience: Open to a range of experience levels
Salary: $90,000–$120,000 Base + Equity, depending on experience
Status: Full-time, based in Cambridge, MA
Travel: 60 – 80%
Company Overview
Elemental Machines is a Cambridge, MA-based technology company connecting the physical and digital worlds in life sciences. Our solutions transform how R&D labs and commercial manufacturing organizations turn equipment and operational data into actionable intelligence. Our connectivity and intelligence platform combines sensors (IoT), cloud technologies, analytics and artificial intelligence to provide customers visibility across global enterprise operations, enabling them to protect, comply, optimize and accelerate. We serve leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, healthcare and laboratory service organizations.
Our culture is built on drive, commitment, thoughtfulness and creativity. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a collaborative, interdisciplinary, entrepreneurial environment.
Position Summary
Elemental Machines is growing the team that works directly with customers to turn laboratory and manufacturing data into business results using AI. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will go inside the laboratories and production sites of leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies, find the problems that matter most and build the AI solutions that solve them. Your work in the field will directly shape our platform.
This position can accommodate a range of experience. If this kind of work is new to you, you will start alongside our senior team and take the lead on your own engagements as you grow. If you have done it before, you will lead engagements from the first conversation through deployment from the start.
In Cambridge, you will work side by side with our product and engineering teams, so that what you learn from customers is carried directly into our platform.
Expect to spend about 75% of your time at customer sites. That is where this work happens: inside the labs and plants where our customers run their science and manufacturing. You will see more laboratories, production sites and real challenges in a year than most engineers see in several. If you want to work close to customers and the science they are trying to advance, this role is built for you.
Responsibilities
Work on site in customer laboratories and facilities to learn their workflows and data, and identify the problems that most need to be solved
Define requirements together with the customer, and translate business needs into technical designs with agreed scope and measures of success
Connect laboratory instruments, sensors and enterprise systems such as LIMS and ERP to our platform, and prepare the data for analysis and AI
Build applications, integrations and data pipelines that use large language models
Present findings and solutions to scientists, IT teams and executives
Identify needs that recur across customers, and turn field solutions into platform-wide capabilities
185 Alewife Brook Parkway, Suite 401 | Cambridge, MA 02138
elementalmachines.com
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or a related technical field
Proficiency in Python and SQL, demonstrated through work, coursework or projects
Working knowledge of APIs, databases and cloud services
Ability to work directly with customers, understand their business needs and design technical solutions that meet them
Clear written and verbal communication with technical and nontechnical audiences
Ability to travel approximately 75% of the time within the U.S. and internationally on an ongoing basis, sometimes on short notice
Preferred Qualifications
We care about what you have accomplished. Strong candidates will be able to show:
A track record of success as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer, software engineer or technology consultant
Software you built that customers rely on in production
Customer engagements or deployments you led to a successful outcome
Applications you built with large language models (e.g., Claude, GPT, Gemini) that are in real use
Hands-on work with AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Strong working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript
Software validation, data security or access controls you have implemented
Work in life sciences, laboratory, IoT or GxP-regulated environments
If you meet the required qualifications and some of the preferred ones, we encourage you to apply. We do not expect any one candidate to have all of them.
What We Offer
A collaborative and collegial work environment; a high-performing, ambitious team
A role at the intersection of AI, engineering and customer impact, with real ownership and opportunity to grow
Competitive compensation package, including equity
Strong benefits program including health, dental and vision insurance and 401(k) plan
Elemental Machines is an equal opportunity employer. We hire from a variety of backgrounds to advance our technical, scientific and market initiatives.
If you have a GitHub profile or other projects you are proud of, please include a link. We would love to see what you have built.

We are looking for highly motivated recent college graduates At DoorDash, our product engineers implement and operate technological solutions to improve the experiences of our merchants, dashers, and consumers. From creating beautiful, user-friendly flows to crafting scalable backend architectures, we strive to deliver reliant, performant technology that delights our customers.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Develop, maintain and ship technical elements with the support of your mentor, manager, and team members
Act on feedback, coaching, and mentorship from your mentor and team members
Actively learn about the elements to which you contribute
Make a direct impact on our business by collaborating with your team to solve problems for our customers
We're excited about you because you have…
You recently graduated from a Canadian university with a B.S. or M.S. Degree in Computer Science or equivalent and graduated between Fall 2026-Summer 2027
At least 2 previous Software Engineering internships or equivalent work experience with no more than 2 years of full-time work experience
Experience working with databases (e.g. SQL)
Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures

Experience writing clean code, working with version control, and unit testing

Able to analyze and improve efficiency, scalability, and stability of various systems
Excited to develop, release, and run large-scale web applications
Experience with solutions for systems monitoring, live deployments, and continuous integration
Experience with real-time technology problems
Experience working with service oriented architecture, writing APIs, and designing systems
Compensation
Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.
In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.
DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.
Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.
To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.
The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.
$94,500—$118,000 CAD
About DoorDash
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. About The Company
SynergisticIT works with organizations seeking technology professionals and supports candidates as they develop skills for careers in software development, data, and related fields. Our focus is connecting technical talent with opportunities where thoughtful problem-solving, continuous learning, and dependable execution matter. We value practical engineering, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to building and maintaining technology solutions. As projects and client needs vary, team members may contribute across different industries, product environments, and stages of the software development lifecycle.
About The Role
SynergisticIT is seeking a Software Developer to contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications. This role is suited to a professional who enjoys solving technical problems, learning new tools, and working with teammates to deliver reliable solutions. You will help translate functional requirements into maintainable code and participate in development activities from initial planning through implementation and support. Depending on project needs, assignments may involve web applications, backend services, databases, cloud platforms, or data-driven systems. The successful candidate will be adaptable, attentive to detail, and comfortable receiving feedback while taking ownership of assigned work.
Qualifications
A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent education, training, or practical experience may also be considered. Candidates should have foundational programming knowledge in one or more languages, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, C#, or a comparable language. Familiarity with object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, databases, and software development principles is expected. Experience with SQL, version control systems such as Git, and common development tools is beneficial. Exposure to web technologies, APIs, cloud services, automated testing, or Agile practices is an advantage. Applicants should be able to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly, and work both independently and collaboratively. A willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and adapt to changing project priorities is important.
Responsibilities
Develop, enhance, and maintain software features in accordance with project requirements and established coding standards. Collaborate with engineers, analysts, quality assurance professionals, and other stakeholders to understand user needs and clarify technical specifications. Write readable, reusable, and well-documented code, and participate in code reviews to improve quality and share knowledge. Create and execute unit, integration, or functional tests; identify defects; and help resolve issues throughout the development lifecycle. Support the integration of applications with databases, APIs, and other systems. Use version control and project tracking tools to manage work, communicate progress, and maintain an accurate record of changes. Contribute to technical documentation and assist with deployment, monitoring, and ongoing application support as needed. Follow security, privacy, performance, and reliability practices appropriate to each project. Seek feedback, build technical expertise, and contribute ideas that improve team processes and software outcomes.

Benefits and employment arrangements depend on the position, project, and applicable employment terms. Eligible employees may have access to health coverage, paid time off, retirement programs, professional development resources, and other benefits offered by the relevant employer. Specific compensation, work location, schedule, and benefit details will be shared during the hiring process and confirmed in the applicable offer documents.
Equal Opportunity
SynergisticIT is committed to fair and inclusive employment practices. Employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, without discrimination on any basis protected by applicable law. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations during the application and hiring process when requested.

rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
What is your role?
How could technology shape the future relationship between farmers and advisors? That is the question our small, customer-facing Innovation team is exploring. As a Full-Stack Prototyping Engineer, you turn early ideas into working prototypes and put them in the hands of farmers and advisors to learn what really works.
You enjoy moving quickly, experimenting and learning through doing. Rather than spending months polishing a concept, you build something tangible within days. You bring together front-end, back-end, AI components and data sources to test ideas in real-life farming environments. Some ideas will prove valuable; others will be stopped. Both outcomes are an important part of the process.
Your Main Responsibilities Include
Turn early-stage ideas into working prototypes, from a first concept to something farmers and advisors can interact with.
Build full-stack applications using React, TypeScript and Next.js, connecting front-end experiences with back-end services, APIs, AI components and data sources.
Work with Azure SQL and contribute to deploying and running applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), using tools such as Terraform and GitLab CI.
Work directly with farmers and advisors to test prototypes in realistic situations, gather feedback and translate observations into improvements or new hypotheses.
Make pragmatic technical and design decisions, while ensuring that prototypes have the necessary foundations for security, monitoring and reliability.
Share insights and validated concepts with the teams responsible for further development and scaling.
Apply now

rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
About Phi Partners
Phi Partners has been a trusted capital markets consultancy for more than 20 years, providing quantitative and technology expertise across front office, pricing and risk. We support more than 80 financial institutions across the buy-side and sell-side through niche capabilities spanning quant, engineering, vendor platforms and cloud infrastructure. Our teams work on complex, real-world problems across models, analytics, applications, data and cloud infrastructure, within an international delivery organisation built around regional hubs and specialist centres of excellence.
Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialised in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our brand-new Budapest Centre-of-Excellence, located in Bank Centre in Old Town, is our latest addition to our Quantitative, Front Office & Risk Technology Services global teams.
Our consultants will have the opportunity to be mentored by well-known industry-leading professionals based in Budapest and abroad, and work for a variety of top-tier clients including the world’s largest Investment Banks, Asset Management Companies, and market-leading Hedge Funds. We support organic talent growth in Hungary, as well as facilitate Quant Developers and Front Office Technologists & Engineers who have worked abroad to relocate to Hungary.
About The Programme
As part of our partnerships with various clients, we are currently expanding our quant teams to keep pace with the rapid growth in this business. Our consultants gain exposure to a variety of projects across asset classes as well as coverage areas (such as front office, pricing & analytics, risk and more), with each project typically taking 12 to 18 months. As a firm we engage in a wide range of quant services including but not limited to:
Model integration into quant libraries as well as quant library upgrades / refactoring
Quantitative development, which includes refining and optimizing the code base for performance
Front office rapid application development and engineering, including directly supporting the trading desks
IT and Engineering work such as improving the backend infrastructure and computation platforms
Roles & Responsibilities
Our projects will involve practical implementation of the pricing or risk models into sophisticated quant libraries as well as extensive IT/Technology scope.
You will get the opportunity to work closely with fellow quant developers, model developers, quant analysts, library quants, front office IT engineers and other stakeholders. On a day-to-day basis, a quant developer consultant in our Centre of Excellence will work on projects which involve:
Integrating pricing models and quant libraries into highly connected IT systems of our clients
Close collaboration with all the Quants, Quant Developers and Software Engineers within Front Office IT (including those from within Phi as well as those from the client’s team)
Developing frameworks and architecture for implementing financial product models into the quantitative library in a robust and suitable manner for their intended purposes
Implementing efficient algorithms to preprocess and manipulate large volumes of data, ensuring data integrity and consistency
Writing clean, well-documented, and efficient code in Python, C++, C#, Java or other coding languages
Working on complex computation and software engineering challenges
Building and/or scaling real-time, multithreaded applications on a distributed architecture using synchronous and asynchronous programming techniques
Key Skills
To be successful as a Quant Developer, the ideal candidate will bring the following skills:
Educational qualifications in a discipline such as computer science, software or IT engineering, applied mathematics, quantitative finance, physics, or similar fields; Masters’ or above highly preferred
Experience (including Internships) working on software development projects, ideally as a Quantitative Developer or IT Quant at an investment bank, hedge fund, specialist consulting firm or financial institution; relevant personal projects are also of interest
Excellent programming skills in Python, C++, C# or Java (Object Oriented and Functional)
Writing clean code using SOLID principles
Willingness to work in Agile software development environments
Strong consultancy and client services mindset
Proven track record of working with international stakeholders
Good documentation and communication skills
English proficiency is a must
Next Steps
This is an excellent opportunity to establish yourself within a rapidly expanding consultancy firm in a high growth Quantitative Centre of Excellence led by recognised industry leaders, built on a foundation rooted in academic rigour and a culture of R&D and software engineering best practices. The right professional can grow their skills and abilities while continuing to actively contribute in a hands-on technical manner on challenging global projects.
Graduates & Young Professionals are encouraged to apply but note that we may recommend an Internship/Graduate Program position if it is more appropriate.
Posted on 16th Oct 2026

: AI/ML Engineer, Internal Platforms
Role Type
: Full-time
Location
: Remote
The Role
Join our team to build and improve a next-generation AI recruiting agent. You'll develop new capabilities, experiment with the latest LLMs and agent frameworks, and ship production-ready AI features that make the agent smarter, more reliable, and more useful.
What You'll Do
1. Build and improve AI agent capabilities using modern LLMs.
2. Develop backend services and APIs in Python.
3. Design and iterate on prompts, workflows, RAG, and agent orchestration.
4. Evaluate model performance and continuously improve quality through experimentation.
5. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver AI-powered features.
6. Deploy and maintain scalable AI systems in production.
7. Stay current with the latest AI models, tools, and best practices.

1. Strong Python software engineering skills.
2. Experience building applications with LLMs and AI APIs.
3. Familiarity with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex.
4. Experience building APIs with FastAPI or similar frameworks.
5. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
6. Strong problem-solving skills and an experimental mindset.
7. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
1. Experience shipping AI products or AI agents to production.
2. Familiarity with RAG, tool calling, model evaluation, or prompt engineering.
3. Contributions to open-source AI projects or personal AI applications.
4. Experience working in fast-paced, AI-first environments.

Job Summary
The Life Data Platform (LDP) & Data Enablement team is responsible for acquiring, integrating, governing, modeling, and publishing enterprise data across on-premises and cloud platforms. The team enables trusted, scalable, and business-ready data products, analytics, reporting, and operational insights for Life Insurance functions through AWS, Dremio, Data Catalog, and modern data engineering practices.
The Associate Data Engineer will support the design, development, and maintenance of data pipelines, data models, and enterprise data products that enable reporting, analytics, and operational use cases. This role combines hands-on data engineering with stakeholder collaboration, working closely with data engineers, business partners, analysts, and technology teams to deliver reliable and scalable data solutions while growing technical expertise in cloud-based data platforms.

4-6 years of total professional experience

Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict.
At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI.
About The Role
Fundamental is seeking a Forward Deployed Full-Stack Engineer to build the critical integration layers and interfaces that allow our customers to adopt NEXUS.
The Forward Deployed Engineer is an integral part of our FDE team, dedicated to driving the successful deployment of Fundamental products. While our ML engineers focus on the model performance, you will focus on usability, integration, and system reliability. You will work hand-in-hand with customers from the Proof of Value stage to post-implementation, ensuring our solutions are not just accurate, but accessible, secure, and seamlessly embedded in the client's production workflow. In this role, you’ll manage technical relationships with multiple stakeholders (IT security, application owners, and business users) and function as a key bridge, translating field requirements into features for our platform roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
You’ll individually architect and build production-grade applications that wrap our core models, turning projects into intuitive, high-value user experiences
You’ll lead the last mile engineering efforts, handling API integration, data visualization, and authentication/security requirements (SSO, RBAC) within complex enterprise environments (VPC, on-prem, air-gapped)
You’ll design and implement performant backend services to ingest customer data and serve model predictions at scale, ensuring low latency and high availability
You’ll work in collaboration with our research and product teams to translate operational friction - such as data ingestion difficulties or UI gaps - into essential inputs for the Fundamental roadmap
Your collaboration with the Sales and Solution Architect teams will help align diverse stakeholders, building dashboards and tools that allow business users to inspect, trust, and act on predictions
Must have
You hold a BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
You have 5+ years as a Full-Stack Engineer, with a track record of shipping production code in complex environments
You have deep proficiency in modern frontend frameworks (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and data visualization libraries (D3.js, Recharts, or similar)
You have strong experience with backend development (Python/FastAPI, Go, or Node.js) and database design (PostgreSQL, Redis)
You have experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
You are comfortable navigating enterprise security constraints and have experience integrating with identity providers (LDAP, SAML, OIDC)
You hold strong communication skills with an ability to translate architectural nuances into clear business value for non-technical stakeholders
Nice to have
Experience building tools for Data Science or ML workflows (e.g., labeling interfaces, model monitoring dashboards)
Experience with cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Technical Consultant in a B2B software company
Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Pandas, PySpark) to better collaborate with our ML counterparts
Benefits
Competitive compensation with salary and equity
Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents, including medical, dental, vision, and 401K
Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys
Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations
A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

LoopTech started in 2024 with a question that kept coming up: why is the distance between what AI can do in a lab and what organizations can use so wide? We set out to close it. Our goal is to create intelligent systems that understand and adapt to human needs. We are a research and development group, part think tank and part engineering shop. We live at the edge of what is possible and work backward toward what is practical. We dig into hard problems, build from what we find, and ship tools that teams can put to work the same week they receive them.
LoopTech is part of Cook Medical, a company that operates in regulated industries where precision, privacy, and reliability are requirements. That discipline is in our DNA. If you want to turn research into tools people use, and you want the backing of an established medical device company, we would like to meet you!

Overview
This role is for engineers at the start of their careers who are eager to learn, grow, and make an immediate impact. It’s a general posting, so we’ll get to know your skills, interests, and career goals and align you with a team where you can do your best work. You’ll work on real problems alongside experienced engineers, designers, and cross-functional partners. You’ll get hands-on guidance, detailed feedback, and mentorship as you learn proven engineering practices and see your work launch. You’ll also build fluency with AI tools and learn to use them responsibly to work smarter.
We're cultivating a culture that prioritizes innovators, risk-takers, and imaginative thinkers. You’ll help create solutions that transform how millions of consumers and small businesses manage their finances in cloud, platform, mobile, and SaaS environments. Working in a culture that embraces experimentation and rapid prototyping, you’ll collaborate closely with customers and cross-functional teams, turning ideas into real impact while building the skills to launch a rewarding career.
Responsibilities
Across all tech stacks:
Build and ship features for our core products and the systems that power engineering operations, and see your work reach customers.
Learn and apply proven practices for designing, building, testing, and supporting software.
Use AI tools responsibly to speed up your work, and share what you learn with your team.
Turn customer feedback into small, meaningful improvements, using methods like Design for Delight.
Collaborate with peers, designers, and engineers, and use code reviews, mentorship, and feedback to grow.
Focus Areas
Frontend: Build responsive, dynamic web applications with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks such as React, AngularJS, or Vue.js. Partner with designers, UX specialists, and backend engineers.
Backend: Build web services in Java, Python, or Node.js. Work with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB, and design and integrate RESTful APIs using frameworks such as Express, Spring MVC, or Django.
Full stack: Work across frontend and backend, discuss application and API architecture, and contribute on Agile/Scrum teams using tools like Git, Jenkins, or Travis.
Mobile: Build Android or iOS applications using tools such as React Native, Flutter, Xcode, Android Studio, Swift, Objective-C, or Java. Integrate them with cloud-based APIs.
Qualifications
Completed a degree-seeking program in Computer Science or a related technical field within the last 12 months.
Less than 12 months of relevant professional work experience (not including internships, co-ops, or work study).
Foundational understanding of Agile development, object-oriented design, and programming principles.
Coursework, internships, personal projects, or academic experience in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, C++).
Basic knowledge of front-end web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.
Awareness of AI concepts, including Generative AI, plus curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to apply them in your daily work.
Strong written, verbal, and collaboration skills.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new priorities, tools, and technologies in a fast-paced environment.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Mountain View $55.5 - $75
New York $57.5- $78
San Diego, CA $53.5- $72

rejeitadas.titulo: Research Software Engineer I - Laboratory of Dr. Talmo Pereira
rejeitadas.descricao_resumida: Salk Institute for Biological Studies - San Diego Metropolitan Area
rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
The Pereira Lab at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies is seeking a Research Software Engineer to build and maintain the software that turns computer vision models into biological discovery. The lab develops SLEAP, an open-source deep learning framework for markerless pose estimation used by research groups worldwide, and operates the research software, analysis pipelines, and computing infrastructure that carry model outputs through to published science. Research Software Engineers often come from science themselves — computationally minded researchers who found that they most enjoyed building the tools, software, and infrastructure that make discovery possible. The role sits at the interface of research and software engineering, but it is grounded in the research side: unlike a conventional software engineer who builds to fixed product specifications, a Research Software Engineer works shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists to turn their evolving needs into working tools. It is an ideal early-career role for someone who has done research and discovered that they love to code and build systems, and it can serve equally as the foundation of a long-term research software engineering career in academia or industry.
The Research Software Engineer I will own the research software behind the Institute’s plant root phenotyping program: containerized, GPU-accelerated pipelines that take raw images from automated scanners, run deep learning pose-estimation models over them, extract quantitative traits, and deliver analysis-ready results to collaborating laboratories. The role spans the full path that data travels: the desktop acquisition software running on the scanners, Bloom — the web application and database where images and results live — the open-source Python packages that extract traits, and the deep learning models at the center of it. In practice this means maintaining full-stack web and desktop applications, releasing Python packages under rigorous continuous integration, running and improving model training and inference, and working directly with plant biologists to turn their experimental questions into reproducible analyses. The Research Software Engineer I works alongside the SLEAP team that develops the underlying pose-estimation framework, and contributes to those open-source tools as part of the role. Including a link to a GitHub profile (or equivalent portfolio) with examples of previous programming work is strongly recommended for full consideration. We recognize that code written for previous employers is often proprietary and cannot be shared publicly, so this is not required; however, candidates who can point to non-coursework repositories — such as personal projects or contributions to open-source software will be highly preferred.
Who We Are
The Salk Institute is an internationally renowned research institution that values all members of our scientific community. We seek bold and interactive leaders passionate about exploring new frontiers in science. Our collaborative community embraces perspectives across discipline, professional acumen, and unique life experiences, fostering innovation, and a sense of belonging. Together, we strive to improve the wellbeing of humanity through groundbreaking research.
Founded by Jonas Salk, developer of the first safe and effective polio vaccine, the Institute is an independent, nonprofit research organization and architectural landmark: small by choice, intimate by nature, and fearless in the face of any challenge. Salk's vibrant community has many talented individuals from varied backgrounds, each playing a crucial role in driving our mission forward. From visionary leaders to dedicated administrators and brilliant faculty members, the Institute is united by a shared passion for scientific exploration and innovation.
What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be
Develop, maintain, and release open-source scientific Python packages for pose-estimation-based phenotyping, following professional software engineering practices including version control (Git), code review, testing, type checking, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
Maintain and extend Bloom, the lab’s web application and scientific database for plant phenotyping data, spanning backend services, the API, the web frontend, schema design, and deployment on self-hosted infrastructure.
Maintain and release Bloom Desktop, the Electron/React application used on the plate and cylinder scanners to acquire images and upload them to Bloom, including its integration with camera and data-acquisition hardware.
Stand up, deploy, and maintain self-hosted systems and services on lab servers and cloud infrastructure, including database backup and restore, object storage, and TLS certificate management.
Build, operate, and improve containerized, GPU-accelerated analysis pipelines that carry raw imaging data through deep learning inference to quantitative trait outputs.
Train, evaluate, and deploy deep learning pose-estimation models, and maintain the datasets, configurations, and model registries that make training runs reproducible.
Connect analysis pipelines to Bloom through well-defined data contracts, provenance tracking, and write-back of results to the database.
Run analyses on experimental datasets for collaborating laboratories and deliver the results as documented, reproducible reports and figures.
Support and make use of shared high-performance computing resources, including GPU cluster scheduling and containerized job workflows (e.g., Kubernetes-based schedulers, SLURM).
Rapidly prototype, build, and iterate on internal applications, command-line tools, and utilities in response to evolving scientific needs.
Integrate systems and services through APIs, authentication, and automation to create seamless workflows for end users.
Work directly with biologists and other scientists to understand their experimental goals and translate them into technical solutions.
Prepare and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials that enable researchers to use the tools and pipelines independently.
Contribute to the lab’s open-source software community, including reviewing external contributions and responding to user issues.
Participate in project planning and status discussions, and coordinate with other Salk labs, Core facilities, and programs.
May assist with the onboarding or supervision of student trainees and interns.
Perform additional duties as assigned.
Supervisory Responsibilities
This position has no supervisory responsibilities.
What We Require
BS degree in computer science, engineering, quantitative science, or a related discipline is preferred for this position.
This is an early-career role; no prior professional experience is required. Demonstrated software engineering ability — through internships, research projects, open-source contributions, or personal projects — is essential.
Full-stack software engineering ability, including proficiency in Python and at least one other language (TypeScript preferred), and experience building complete applications spanning back-end logic, front-end interfaces, and data storage.
Proficiency with the scientific Python stack (e.g., NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn), including the ability to build complete, tested, documented packages rather than one-off scripts.
Experience designing and querying relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL), including schema changes and migrations.
Working familiarity with at least one deep learning framework (e.g., PyTorch) and a conceptual understanding of how models are trained, evaluated, and deployed.
Demonstrated interest in computer vision and in open-source software development. This role works alongside the SLEAP team, whose primary products are public, community-used research tools, and contributing in the open is part of the everyday job.
Fluency with modern, AI-assisted software development, including the effective use of AI coding tools and large language models (e.g., Claude Code) to design, build, debug, and ship software rapidly.
Demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies quickly and to stand up working services and pipelines through code, scripting, and automation.
Comfort working in Linux/Unix environments with version control (Git), testing, and code review.
Preferred
Master’s degree or post-baccalaureate certification in a computational or scientific field.
Prior internship, research, or work experience in a scientific, laboratory, or academic environment.
Full-stack web development experience with modern frameworks (e.g., React, Svelte, Vue, FastAPI, Django).
Desktop application development, particularly with Electron or a comparable framework.
Experience integrating software with scientific instruments or hardware, such as cameras, scanners, or data-acquisition devices.
Experience with computer vision or image analysis, particularly on large scientific image datasets.
Experience with containerization (e.g., Docker) and with scheduling work on GPU resources (e.g., Kubernetes, SLURM); prior high-performance computing or systems-administration experience is welcome but not required.
Experience deploying and maintaining self-hosted applications and services, including on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP).
Experience maintaining an open-source software project, including packaging, releases, and responding to community issues.
Academic coursework, research experience, or demonstrated interest in plant science, biology, neuroscience, or another life-science domain.
A track record of shipping small tools or projects quickly and independently, and of picking up new languages, frameworks, and systems with minimal ramp-up.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with scientists to translate their needs into technical solutions.
A public code portfolio (e.g., GitHub) that demonstrates initiative beyond coursework, such as personal projects or contributions to open-source software.
What We Can Offer
The expected pay range for this position is $33.00 to $38.00 an hour.
 Salk Institute provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the institute reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, and external market pay for comparable jobs.
Benefits
Salk Institute offers competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, patient advocacy services, and transit/parking program.
Salk Values
The Salk Community, both scientists and administrators, worked together to define values that we believe support Salk’s pursuit of excellence. To be truly the best scientific institution requires not only incredible discoveries, but a common understanding of how we should work together to enable those discoveries.
The acronym “I CARE” provides a simple way to remember each of the values and reminds each of us of the importance of what we do each day.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
Residency
All applicants must reside in the United States at the time of application.
Overview
BigBear.ai is seeking a Full Stack Developer to support mission-focused product development that advances enterprise data and analytics capabilities for national security customers. In this role, you’ll contribute production-ready code across backend services and frontend user experiences, partnering closely with a cross-functional product team in an Agile/DevOps environment. You’ll participate in feature delivery end-to-end—design, implementation, testing, code reviews, deployment support, and technical demonstrations, helping ensure our platform remains reliable, scalable, and ready for real-world operations.
What You Will Do
Design, develop, and maintain full-stack capabilities across user interfaces, backend microservices, and web services in support of mission-critical outcomes.
Build and enhance APIs and service integrations (e.g., REST-based services using frameworks such as FastAPI).
Automate manual analytical workflows and enable repeatable, scalable processing pipelines.
Contribute to cloud-native solutions on AWS, including deployment, monitoring, and operational support.
Develop and integrate persistent data solutions using databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
Support enterprise data flow/orchestration solutions (e.g., Apache NiFi).
Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, technical troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
Provide Tier 3 technical support for deployed applications and databases, including diagnosing and resolving complex issues in production environments.
Collaborate on release planning, deployment procedures, and documentation (e.g., Jira/Confluence), ensuring transparency and operational readiness.
Support off-hours deployments as needed (evenings/weekends) to meet mission timelines and operational requirements.
Participate in team demos and stakeholder presentations to showcase platform capabilities and progress.
What You Need To Have
4+ years of relevant software development experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Active TS/SCI clearance (required)
Hands-on experience with:
Python
REST API development (e.g., FastAPI or similar frameworks)
AWS cloud environments
Docker and containerization
Git-based version control (GitHub/GitLab)
PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB
Agile development methodology (Scrum/Kanban)
Collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, delivery-oriented product team and produce high-quality, maintainable code
What We'd Like You To Have
Apache NiFi experience (strong plus)
Experience with Amazon RDS
Kubernetes experience, particularly Amazon EKS
Familiarity with architecture and design patterns for scalable systems and microservices
Experience integrating identity and access management solutions (e.g., Keycloak)
Experience designing or working with OpenAI API-compatible API patterns
Exposure to LLM-assisted development workflows (e.g., using AI tools to improve productivity while maintaining code quality and security)
Pay transparency
Please note the targeted compensation range is provided as an estimate, and any actual compensation offer may vary depending on the needs of the company, or an applicant's skillset, competencies, experience, education, certifications, location, or other factors. The estimated range does not include the value of any benefits offered.
About BigBear.ai
BigBear.ai is a leading provider of AI-powered decision intelligence solutions for national security, supply chain management, and digital identity. Customers and partners rely on Bigbear.ai’s predictive analytics capabilities in highly complex, distributed, mission-based operating environments. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, BigBear.ai is a public company traded on the NYSE under the symbol BBAI. For more information, visit https://bigbear.ai/ and follow BigBear.ai on LinkedIn: @BigBear.ai and X: @BigBearai.
BigBear.ai is an Equal opportunity employer all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
What You’ll Do
The Strategy and Transformation team builds intelligent systems and first-party applications that improve how CoreWeave’s internal teams work. The team partners with Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and core business operations to connect workflows across enterprise platforms, including ERP, HRIS, MRP, PDM, and DCIM.
About The Role
As a Software and AI Engineer, IT Systems, you’ll design and build AI agents, copilots, and first-party applications that make CoreWeave’s internal workflows more intelligent, automated, and intuitive. You’ll work across applied AI, product design, and full-stack engineering—from agentic workflows built with integration platforms and AI frameworks to React interfaces and backend services in Node.js and Go.
In This Role, You Will
Develop AI agents and copilots for Finance, Billing, Supply Chain, and other internal teams, using frameworks and APIs such as LangChain, LangGraph, Cohere, OpenAI, Gemini, and Glean.
Design and build first-party web and mobile applications using React, TypeScript, and modern front-end frameworks.
Develop scalable backend services in Node.js and Go for data processing, orchestration, and automation.
Integrate enterprise systems—including ERP, HRIS, MRP, PDM, DCIM, and data warehouses—through native integrations or iPaaS platforms such as Workato or Boomi.
Build APIs and microservices that support modular, event-driven application architectures.
Use GenAI development tools such as Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT Codex to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation.
Build observability, maintainability, and security into applications across the stack.
Partner with stakeholders in Finance, Accounting, Security, Engineering, and other business teams to design useful, user-centered workflows.
Who You Are
You have 3+ years of programming experience in C++, Go, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Python, building production-grade cloud services.
You have 3+ years of scripting experience in Python or Bash for automation and tooling.
You have solid experience designing RESTful APIs and event-driven integration architectures.
You have experience building and deploying production-grade applications and microservices.
You have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration, and DevOps and CI/CD practices.
You have experience with modern backend and frontend technologies; familiarity with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Go, FastAPI, Next.js, Kestrel, or gRPC is relevant to this role.
You’re familiar with generative AI frameworks and APIs, such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, or Glean, and how they can be applied in products.
You’re motivated by building user-facing tools that improve business productivity and employee experience.
Preferred Skills
Experience shipping production-grade AI, ML, or LLM-based applications at scale.
Experience developing AI-powered or agentic applications integrated with enterprise data.
Familiarity with machine learning and data engineering platforms such as Ray, Kafka, or Spark.
Experience with iPaaS platforms such as Workato or Boomi.
Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, or other operational domains where intelligent automation can drive efficiency.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT Codex.
A collaborative approach and an eye for user experience and long-term system maintainability.
Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds—even if you don’t check every box. Here are a few qualities we’ve found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.
You’re curious about how AI and software can make everyday work simpler and more effective.
You enjoy turning complex business needs into clear, approachable experiences.
You communicate well with both technical and non-technical partners and like building solutions together.
You balance moving quickly with building systems that are secure, maintainable, and dependable.
Why CoreWeave?
About
At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:
Be Curious at Your Core
Act Like an Owner
Empower Employees
Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
Achieve More Together
We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
The base salary range for this role is $153,000 to $204,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).
What We Offer
The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.
In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave
Company-paid Life Insurance 
Voluntary supplemental life insurance 
Short and long-term disability insurance 
Flexible Spending Account
Health Savings Account
Tuition Reimbursement 
Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health 
Family-Forming support provided by Carrot
Paid Parental Leave 
Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside
401(k) with a generous employer match
Flexible PTO
Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations
A casual work environment
A work culture focused on innovative disruption
California Applicants
California Consumer Privacy Act 
Equal Opportunity & Accommodations
CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.
As part of this commitment and consistent with the 
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
, CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.
Export Control Compliance
This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C.
1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. About AlphaSense
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
Check Out What We’ve Built So Far
Our Helsinki team consists of 100 tech professionals; +26 different nationalities. We pride ourselves on being client-focused and collaborative, on the pioneering edge of technology. We also have fun. Whether it’s office happy hours, team outings, or game nights, we believe in working with people we like to hang out with.
Ideal candidate traits
If you identify as a team player and you are humble, hungry, and smart with Sisu — we would love to get to know you. We believe these qualities to be vital to building a strong, productive, and collaborative work environment, where everyone is committed to achieving common goals and working towards shared success.
We are looking for people who are willing to learn from others, who can put their egos aside and prioritize the needs of the team. You should also be highly motivated, driven to succeed, and always looking for ways to improve. We value emotional intelligence, excellent communication skills, and a collaborative spirit that enables them to build strong relationships with teammates and work effectively towards shared goals.
