Job Description
Software Developer (Applied AI)
You will be working on a 100% remote schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement. 
Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings. 
At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services - and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.
Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best - both personally and professionally.
What You Will Do
The 
Software Developer, Applied AI
 reports to the Manager, Applied AI and is responsible for designing, building, testing and deploying practical, secure and governed AI solutions for Fidelity Investments Canada. The role has a strong focus on 
generative AI, agentic AI and modern software engineering
, while contributing to reusable Applied AI foundations that can be scaled across multiple business use cases.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is passionate about emerging technology and enjoys turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into practical, production-ready solutions. The successful candidate will work directly with business and technology partners to understand problems and opportunities, translate them into AI use cases, rapidly experiment with potential solutions and mature successful prototypes into reliable enterprise applications.
The role will also work closely with the Manager, Applied AI, Fidelity International, Architecture, Security and AI Governance to ensure solutions are scalable, observable, secure and governed, while maintaining flexibility across models, technology platforms and vendors.
What You Will Do
Partner directly with business, product and technology teams to understand business problems and translate them into well-defined AI use cases and technical requirements; build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept and develop successful ideas into production-quality AI and agentic applications, APIs and services.
Build and extend Applied AI foundations, including reusable patterns for model access, RAG and enterprise knowledge, agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, observability and deployment. Develop cloud-native components using technologies such as AWS, Snowflake and Kubernetes.
Design modular and portable AI components that preserve strategic flexibility across models, frameworks and vendors, and collaborate with Fidelity International and Architecture teams to reuse and extend enterprise capabilities where appropriate.
Apply modern agentic engineering practices, including prompt and context engineering, LLMs, APIs, tools, memory, RAG, workflow orchestration, evaluations, guardrails and observability.
Build AI solutions with security and governance embedded from the beginning, working closely with AI Governance, Security, Privacy, Risk and Architecture on data access, model and tool usage, human oversight, traceability, monitoring and other required controls.
Continuously evaluate emerging foundation models, agent frameworks and AI engineering techniques through hands-on experimentation. Assess technologies based on capability, security, governance, interoperability, performance, cost and operational complexity, and turn promising approaches into reusable production patterns.
Apply strong software engineering practices across AI applications, including automated testing, CI/CD, security and quality gates, resilient design, error handling, monitoring, logging, fallbacks and cost management.
Support production AI services through observability, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement, monitoring application health as well as model and agent quality, latency, errors and cost.
Contribute to a strong Applied AI engineering culture through design and code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, reusable examples, knowledge sharing and collaboration across business, data, architecture, security, governance and international teams.
The Expertise You Bring 
Strong expertise with advanced Python skills for developing and supporting production-grade APIs, services, and applications.
Experience building and deploying scalable cloud-native solutions using AWS, Snowflake, and Kubernetes.
Proficiency in API development, microservices architecture, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated testing.
Knowledge of Java and/or JavaScript is considered an asset.
Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI Engineering principles and practices.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, tool integration, and prompt/context engineering.
Experience with AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, performance optimization, and cost management.
Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps, including model and agent lifecycle management and evaluation frameworks.
Knowledge of AI security, privacy, responsible AI, and governance-by-design principles.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, and continuous learning capabilities, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
What We’re Looking For
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Economics or Mathematics or equivalent working experience
2+ years of experience in software development, preferably in the financial services/mutual fund/investment industry
Candidates should have demonstrated hands-on experience delivering production software solutions, with practical experience in AI/ML, generative AI or agentic applications strongly preferred.
AWS certification or equivalent hands-on cloud experience is considered an asset.
Experience working within Agile or Scrum environments is an asset.
Total Rewards That Reflect Your Impact
We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a 
competitive compensation package
 designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.
For this role, your total rewards include
Base Salary and Discretionary Performance Bonus Total annual cash compensation (base salary plus target bonus) ranges from $101,000 to $118,000, based on your experience and qualifications.
RRSP Contribution After 6 months of employment, we invest in your future with an RRSP contribution—no employee matching required.
We’re proud to offer a compensation package that aligns with 
provincial pay transparency requirements.
This posting represents an 
existing vacancy
 within our organization—an opportunity to step into a role where your talents will make a meaningful difference.
Some of the ways we will help you feel valued and supported as part of our team
Flexible working arrangements that vary based on role requirements
Competitive total compensation, including company contributions to your group RRSP without a matching requirement from you
Comprehensive health benefits that start on your first day, with 100% employer-paid premiums, that include up to $6000 annually for mental health services and therapy
Parental leave top-up to 100% of your salary for a period of 25 weeks
Up to $650 for home office equipment
Generous time off policy, including 2 paid days annually to volunteer at a charity of your choice
Diversity and inclusion programs, including an active network of Employee Resource Groups
Extensive professional development opportunities, including access to over 11,000 training and development courses, tuition reimbursement, and monetary rewards for completing a required designation 
We care a lot about fostering a compassionate, people-centric culture, and are proud to have been named one of 
Canada’s Top 100 employers
 for the last five years.

rejeitadas.descricao_resumida: Jellyfish - Johanesburgo, Gauteng, África do Sul
rejeitadas.descricao_completa:
Jellyfish is a full service global digital agency, combining strategy, creative, data and media buying and planning expertise with technology under one integrated roof. With almost 2,000 Jellies across 38 offices worldwide, we are the unconventional global marketing partner of the future.
We understand both brand and activation. We ensure our clients reach, influence and connect with the right audiences and fans based on data that reveals the insights to deliver exceptional creative solutions across any platform. In short, we create and deliver culturally relevant creativity that cuts through the clutter and sets hearts (and feeds) on fire.
As part of the Brandtech Group we’re at the forefront of the deployment of GenAI tools across every aspect of what we do and in PencilPro we have the world’s No 1 generative AI platform, revolutionising the process of creative production, distribution and performance prediction.
Job Description
Reporting to the Head of People Development, you will turn our learning ideas into working products. Our Education and Experience team designs how more than 7,000 people across the Brandtech Group learn, grow and perform, and we prototype fast with AI coding tools. You'll take those prototypes and make them into reliable, secure apps that people use every day.
Our goal is to turn all of our learning into an agentic solution that meets employees where they are, so they can learn in real time, in the flow of work. You'll join a small, distributed team, work alongside a senior architect who owns our core platform, and grow your craft as our products grow.
Responsibilities
Build and Ship Learning Products
Turn learning and performance designs into working software and app features.
Help take AI-built prototypes into production, from the front end through to the database.
Build wireframes and working prototypes to test new ideas quickly with real users.
Fix bugs, ship improvements and keep our products running smoothly.
Build Agentic Learning Experiences
Build learning experiences that live inside the tools people already use, with no separate login.
Build on the core platform and agent architecture owned by our senior architect, so employees get the right support at the moment they need it.
Connect Systems and Data
Work with the People Systems team to connect our learning products with our HR system, skills platform and role frameworks.
Maintain integrations across the learning technology stack.
Support the move from several learning platforms to one, including migration of content and records.
Work as Part of a Distributed Team
Collaborate with instructional designers and learning partners across time zones.
Put the employee first, testing with real users and gathering feedback to improve.
Document what you build so others can use, support and extend it.
Qualifications
About 1–3 years building web applications, internal tools or digital products (professional, freelance or substantial personal projects).
Hands-on experience with Python and FastAPI, or a similar Python web framework.
Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy and Alembic, or an equivalent ORM and migration workflow.
You have built server-rendered pages with Jinja2 or a similar templating engine.
Proficient building with Claude Code.
You have deployed at least one working app (personal, academic or professional). Please, share it with us through a portfolio, GitHub or a live demo.
You generate unique ideas and experiment with new methods and technologies to solve complex issues.
When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options and find practical solutions.
You embrace challenges as opportunities and seek feedback to enhance your skills.
Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.
Additional Information
Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.
💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.
👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.
“Jellyfish will give preference to Employment Equity candidates in accordance with the company’s Employment Equity Plan and its Affirmative Action measures.”
Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to 
talentacquisition@jellyfish.com
.
